title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 08:45 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 707 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Now that's some wind! 🌫🌌👀

Several bright active regions and a broad dark EUV region are visible across today’s Sun, with no clear large outward feature in the coronagraph.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
